name: The Colonel of Qin Empire
description: He was an important military attache who guarded the capital during the Qin Dynasty. He was strong, powerful and muscular, and he consistently performed his mission to protect the safety of the capital. He had extraordinary military skills, personally deployed military protection forces to ensure the safety of the capital, and commanded the soldiers to break through the enemy's invasion. The sword in his hand is a powerful weapon. He can swing the sword into a river and kill all the enemies invading the city. The cloak on the back is large and elegant, with a distinct and mighty aura, which intimidate the enemy and boost morale.
